description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Store' within the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension\Opencart\Module'. The class extends a base controller and includes methods for handling display and save operations related to a store module in the OpenCart admin interface.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing the store module in the OpenCart admin panel, providing methods to display the module settings page and save configuration data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the store module configuration page in the admin interface, loads language, sets the page title, prepares breadcrumb navigation, and renders the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to save the store module settings, verifies permissions, updates settings via the model, and returns a JSON response.
